34: // setter tries to set value on a walking by fields of a struct

43: // TrySet tries to set a value by request's form source (like map[string][]string)
44: func (form formSource) TrySet(value reflect.Value, field reflect.StructField, tagValue string, opt setOptions) (isSetted bool, err error) {

48: func mappingByPtr(ptr interface{}, setter setter, tag string) error {
49: 	_, err := mapping(reflect.ValueOf(ptr), emptyField, setter, tag)
50: 	return err
51: }
52: 
53: func mapping(value reflect.Value, field reflect.StructField, setter setter, tag string) (bool, error) {
54: 	var vKind = value.Kind()
55: 
56: 	if vKind == reflect.Ptr {
57: 		var isNew bool
58: 		vPtr := value
59: 		if value.IsNil() {
60: 			isNew = true
61: 			vPtr = reflect.New(value.Type().Elem())
62: 		}
63: 		isSetted, err := mapping(vPtr.Elem(), field, setter, tag)
64: 		if err != nil {
65: 			return false, err
66: 		}
67: 		if isNew && isSetted {
68: 			value.Set(vPtr)
69: 		}
70: 		return isSetted, nil
71: 	}
72: 
73: 	if vKind != reflect.Struct || !field.Anonymous {
74: 		ok, err := tryToSetValue(value, field, setter, tag)
75: 		if err != nil {
76: 			return false, err
77: 		}
78: 		if ok {
79: 			return true, nil
80: 		}
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	if vKind == reflect.Struct {
84: 		tValue := value.Type()
85: 
86: 		var isSetted bool
87: 		for i := 0; i < value.NumField(); i++ {
88: 			sf := tValue.Field(i)
89: 			if sf.PkgPath != "" && !sf.Anonymous { // unexported
90: 				continue
91: 			}
92: 			ok, err := mapping(value.Field(i), tValue.Field(i), setter, tag)
93: 			if err != nil {
94: 				return false, err
95: 			}
96: 			isSetted = isSetted || ok
97: 		}
98: 		return isSetted, nil
99: 	}
100: 	return false, nil
101: }

103: type setOptions struct {
104: 	isDefaultExists bool
105: 	defaultValue    string
106: }

108: func tryToSetValue(value reflect.Value, field reflect.StructField, setter setter, tag string) (bool, error) {
109: 	var tagValue string
110: 	var setOpt setOptions
111: 
112: 	tagValue = field.Tag.Get(tag)
113: 	tagValue, opts := head(tagValue, ",")
114: 
115: 	if tagValue == "-" { // just ignoring this field
116: 		return false, nil
117: 	}
118: 	if tagValue == "" { // default value is FieldName
119: 		tagValue = field.Name
120: 	}
121: 	if tagValue == "" { // when field is "emptyField" variable
122: 		return false, nil
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	var opt string
126: 	for len(opts) > 0 {
127: 		opt, opts = head(opts, ",")
128: 
129: 		if k, v := head(opt, "="); k == "default" {
130: 			setOpt.isDefaultExists = true
131: 			setOpt.defaultValue = v
132: 		}
133: 	}
134: 
135: 	return setter.TrySet(value, field, tagValue, setOpt)
136: }

138: func setByForm(value reflect.Value, field reflect.StructField, form map[string][]string, tagValue string, opt setOptions) (isSetted bool, err error) {
139: 	vs, ok := form[tagValue]
140: 	if !ok && !opt.isDefaultExists {
141: 		return false, nil
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	switch value.Kind() {
145: 	case reflect.Slice:
146: 		if !ok {
147: 			vs = []string{opt.defaultValue}
148: 		}
149: 		return true, setSlice(vs, value, field)
150: 	case reflect.Array:
151: 		if !ok {
152: 			vs = []string{opt.defaultValue}
153: 		}
154: 		if len(vs) != value.Len() {
155: 			return false, fmt.Errorf("%q is not valid value for %s", vs, value.Type().String())
156: 		}
157: 		return true, setArray(vs, value, field)
158: 	default:
159: 		var val string
160: 		if !ok {
161: 			val = opt.defaultValue
162: 		}
163: 
164: 		if len(vs) > 0 {
165: 			val = vs[0]
166: 		}
167: 		return true, setWithProperType(val, value, field)
168: 	}

171: func setWithProperType(val string, value reflect.Value, field reflect.StructField) error {
172: 	switch value.Kind() {
173: 	case reflect.Int:
174: 		return setIntField(val, 0, value)
175: 	case reflect.Int8:
176: 		return setIntField(val, 8, value)
177: 	case reflect.Int16:
178: 		return setIntField(val, 16, value)
179: 	case reflect.Int32:
180: 		return setIntField(val, 32, value)
181: 	case reflect.Int64:
182: 		switch value.Interface().(type) {
183: 		case time.Duration:
184: 			return setTimeDuration(val, value, field)
185: 		}
186: 		return setIntField(val, 64, value)
187: 	case reflect.Uint:
188: 		return setUintField(val, 0, value)
189: 	case reflect.Uint8:
190: 		return setUintField(val, 8, value)
191: 	case reflect.Uint16:
192: 		return setUintField(val, 16, value)
193: 	case reflect.Uint32:
194: 		return setUintField(val, 32, value)
195: 	case reflect.Uint64:
196: 		return setUintField(val, 64, value)
197: 	case reflect.Bool:

199: 	case reflect.Float32:

201: 	case reflect.Float64:

203: 	case reflect.String:

205: 	case reflect.Struct:

207: 		case time.Time:

264: 	timeFormat := structField.Tag.Get("time_format")
265: 	if timeFormat == "" {
266: 		timeFormat = time.RFC3339
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	if val == "" {
270: 		value.Set(reflect.ValueOf(time.Time{}))
271: 		return nil
272: 	}
273: 
274: 	l := time.Local
275: 	if isUTC, _ := strconv.ParseBool(structField.Tag.Get("time_utc")); isUTC {
276: 		l = time.UTC
277: 	}

279: 	if locTag := structField.Tag.Get("time_location"); locTag != "" {

282: 			return err
283: 		}
284: 		l = loc
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	t, err := time.ParseInLocation(timeFormat, val, l)
288: 	if err != nil {
289: 		return err
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	value.Set(reflect.ValueOf(t))

297: 	for i, s := range vals {

299: 		if err != nil {

302: 	}

309: 	if err != nil {
